ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Famy uses your location while the app is open to pin your service address on the map. We do not track your location in the background.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Famy lets you choose photos from your library for your profile picture, payment receipt uploads, and provider verification documents (such as ID).
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Famy uses the camera during live online sessions so you can show video to the other participant.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Famy uses the microphone during live online sessions so you can speak with the other participant.
